episode_summary: In this episode, Bill Melnik shares his journey from Ralph Lauren to becoming a top luxury real estate agent. He discusses the importance of lifestyle marketing, the challenges of pricing luxury properties, and how to leverage social media for lead generation. Bill also provides insights into navigating niche markets and building a personal brand in real estate.
